title: REFRACT Pocket
summary: The pocket sized ZX Spectrum Next emulator.
description:
REFRACT Next turns your M5Stack CardputerZero into a pocket ZX Spectrum Next.

Load .nex, .snx and .sna games straight from the SD card. Pick a fit for the small screen (whole picture, auto, etc.), and play on the built-in keyboard. A USB or Bluetooth pad works too.

Plug in an HDMI screen and the game moves to the big screen at its full 320×256 size, while the CardputerZero stays in your hands as the controller. Five FREE Software Amusements early ZX Spectrum Next games are included to start you off: BubblegumBros, Dweebs Drop, Montana Mike, DeltaStar and Dungeonette.

The ZX Spectrum Next. In your pocket.
